name: Content Review
description: Review a draft with explicit style, risk, and editor approval steps.

steps.name: Check style guide
steps.description: Compare the draft against tone, structure, and clarity requirements.

steps.name: Check factual risk
steps.description: Identify claims that require citations, owner review, or removal.

steps.name: Editor approval
steps.description: Pause before publishing or returning suggested edits.

approval.prompt: Review the style and risk findings before approving the suggested edit path.

steps.name: Record suggested edit
steps.description: Write the approved edit suggestion to the audit log.
